Country.evidence_source: The study was approved by the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research Institutional Review Board at the University of Ghana and a research ethics committee in Norway.

Type.evidence_source: Informants gave both written and verbal informed consent prior to the interview.

Area.evidence_source: the study topic not only is a taboo in Ghana but also stigmatised and legally proscribed. A few informants indeed expressed fear of being handed over to the police for prosecution after the interview. They were also informed of their right to withdraw at any point in time during the interview process and about the availability of a psychologist/counselor should any of them require help following the interview.
